hostname rt-q01
!
class-map match-any cm-q-mark
 match access-group name al-q-biz
class-map match-any cm-q-pq-high
 match dscp 46
class-map match-any cm-q-pq-normal
 match access-group name al-q-biz
class-map match-any cm-q-pq-low
 match any
!
policy-map pm-q-lan
 class cm-q-mark
  set dscp 18
policy-map pm-q-wan
 class cm-q-pq-high
  priority level 1
 class cm-q-pq-normal
  bandwidth remaining percent 75
 class cm-q-pq-low
  bandwidth remaining percent 25
policy-map shape-Gi0-0
 class class-default
  shape average 10000000
  service-policy pm-q-wan
!
interface GigabitEthernet0/0
 ip address 203.0.113.1 255.255.255.252
 service-policy output shape-Gi0-0
 no shutdown
!
interface GigabitEthernet0/1
 ip address 192.0.2.1 255.255.255.0
 service-policy input pm-q-lan
 no shutdown
!
ip route 0.0.0.0 0.0.0.0 203.0.113.2 1
!
ip access-list extended al-q-biz
 permit ip 192.0.2.0 0.0.0.255 198.51.100.0 0.0.0.255
!
end
